comparison.objective: Seat an access panel and place two retainer bars across its edges; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Panel alignment and sequential loose-part placement versus recessed tool engagement, fine collar rotation, counterhold and force-limited tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Panel flush and both bars correctly seated versus repeated non-bottoming deceleration and locked-setting stability.
comparison.reason: The retainer bars are gravity-held placements rather than fastener locking or parameter adjustment. Candidate’s missing rebound, overload and drift thresholds do not imply overlap.
